notes: No hard candidate-count cap, top-k, source-body read, or ancestor-score pruning is permitted.
The flat control uses uncapped semantic weighted path retrieval followed by System One file scoring.
Progressive disclosure starts at root direct children; expansion reveals one directory level.
Directories below both frozen thresholds remain deferred and unresolved, not deleted or marked irrelevant.
The nine frozen primary-target tasks are diagnostic; one repeat does not establish generalization.
All System One requests use the shared SystemOneClient through the existing decider adapter and preserve physical-call JSONL records.
